unit.why: A single narrative about R. Jacob Samson of Shepetivka travelling to collect ransom money and meeting a mysterious old sage in the West who knows R. Baruch of Medzhybizh.

stories.start_quote: הרב הגה״ק מו"ה יעקב שמשון משיפיטיווקא ז״ל
stories.summary_en: R. Jacob Samson of Shepetivka, travelling far west to raise ransom money, lodges with an old sage who asks about R. Baruch of Medzhybizh. He forgets all his master's teachings until he recalls one small interpretation of the Grace after Meals. The sage then expounds its mysteries, and the two spend three days in rapture without food or drink. The sage finally reveals that he knows R. Baruch from the paths of heaven.
